feed.title: Chapter 3: Unsupervised Learning — Civil Engineer's Guide to AI
feed.subtitle: Updates to Chapter 3 sub-lessons.

entry.title: 3.1 Unsupervised Learning Fundamentals
entry.summary: Explore unsupervised learning fundamentals through a civil engineering lens. Understand clustering, dimensionality reduction, anomaly detection, and how machines discover hidden patterns without labelled data.

entry.title: 3.2 K-Means Clustering
entry.summary: Master K-Means clustering through a civil engineering lens. Learn the algorithm step by step, choose the right K with elbow and silhouette methods, cluster soil samples and traffic data, and explore interactive demos.

entry.title: 3.3 Hierarchical Clustering
entry.summary: Learn hierarchical clustering for civil engineering applications. Explore agglomerative and divisive approaches, linkage methods, dendrograms, and interactive demos for material classification and bridge condition grouping.

entry.title: 3.4 DBSCAN & Density-Based Methods
entry.summary: Learn DBSCAN and density-based clustering for civil engineering. Explore epsilon neighborhoods, core/border/noise classification, geospatial sensor clusters, damage zone detection, and interactive demos comparing DBSCAN with K-Means.

entry.title: 3.5 Dimensionality Reduction — PCA
entry.summary: Learn Principal Component Analysis (PCA) for civil engineering. Explore the curse of dimensionality, eigenvalues and eigenvectors, explained variance, scree plots, and interactive demos for reducing multi-sensor bridge monitoring data and compressing soil test results.

entry.title: 3.6 t-SNE & UMAP Visualization
entry.summary: Learn t-SNE and UMAP for non-linear dimensionality reduction and visualization. Explore perplexity, probability distributions, fuzzy topological sets, and interactive demos comparing PCA versus t-SNE on multi-sensor SHM data for civil engineering.

entry.title: 3.7 Anomaly Detection
entry.summary: Learn statistical and machine-learning anomaly detection methods including z-score, IQR, Isolation Forest, Local Outlier Factor, and autoencoders. Explore interactive demos for detecting sensor malfunctions, unusual settlement, and structural response anomalies in civil engineering.

entry.title: 3.8 Association Rules & Pattern Mining
entry.summary: Learn association rule mining with Apriori and FP-growth algorithms. Explore support, confidence, and lift metrics applied to construction defect co-occurrence, material procurement patterns, and safety incident correlations.

entry.title: 3.9 Evaluating Unsupervised Models
entry.summary: Learn how to evaluate unsupervised learning models using silhouette scores, the elbow method, Davies-Bouldin index, and Calinski-Harabasz index. Explore visual inspection strategies and civil engineering applications for validating soil clustering and damage pattern grouping.

entry.title: 3.10 CE Case Study: GIS Land Classification
entry.summary: End-to-end unsupervised learning case study: classifying land use from satellite imagery using spectral indices (NDVI, NDWI) and K-Means clustering for urban planning, environmental assessment, and site selection.
